item.title: Editorial: What happened at Columbia reminds us the University has little recourse against ICE
item.description: At roughly 6:30 a.m. Thursday, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers arrested Columbia senior Elmina Aghayeva in her university-owned apartment. The agents entered the building under false pretenses - allegedly impersonating police officers and claiming to be searching for a missing child. item.title: SciLi shifts from weekday 24-hour access to 2 a.m. closure after security, budget considerations
item.description: Starting Sunday, the Sciences Library will no longer remain open for 24 hours on weeknights. item.title: From the Main Green to Milan: Jacquie Pierri '12 recounts her journey to the 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Jacquie Pierri '12 has at least two things in common with Snoop Dogg: They were both at Spring Weekend in 2010 and at the Milan Cortina Winter Olympics 16 years later. In February, Pierri represented Italy - the games's host country - as a defender for the women's ice hockey team.The first game in Milan was "magical," Pierri said, adding that she had 45 friends and family members fly in to watch her play. item.title: Nearly 50 years ago, R.I. received nearly 30 inches of snow. This is what it looked like.
item.description: Last week, Providence received a record-breaking 37.9 inches of snowfall. Around 48 years earlier, the first snowflakes of the Blizzard of '78 fell.The snow began on Monday, Feb. 6 and over the next 36 hours, nearly 30 inches of snow blanketed the ground, sometimes at a rate of three inches per hour. item.title: Berkwits '29: It's easier for men to get into Brown than women. The benefits are worth it.
item.description: Women outnumber men in higher learning institutions across the country. To combat historical gender inequality in higher education, Congress passed Title IX in 1972, which prohibited gender-based exclusion in educational programs that receive federal financial assistance. Through these efforts, female enrollment in universities surged, and in the late 1970s, women began to outnumber men.
